description: A quiet day for chapter four. Four providers, four sub-locations, eight hourly slots from 09:00. Blake is booked at 12:00, Drew until 11:00, Suite C from 11:00 to 13:00; everyone else is free all day. Casey does not offer the service and Suite D lacks its equipment. 45 feasible two-slot bookings: 2 leave no loose ends (Avery or Blake in Suite C at 09:00, flush against the day start and Suite C's booking), 22 leave one, 21 float in free time and leave two.
